environment: BrailleMe_API_36 read-only emulator; no physical camera claims
timingNote: Record actual action start and end; intended phases are not evidence that they occurred. Keep every successful, rejected and failed capture.
surfaceNote: SurfaceFlinger measures composition, which can include UI redraws. Report it as a preview proxy, not direct proof of camera throughput. The initial phase has no intended shutter actions; analyze camera-service stream counters separately if actual evidence permits.
memoryScope: All 600 seconds, including later photo/rescan cycles.
photoScope: All observed terminal photo metrics, including success, rejection and error; nearest-rank p95. No timing is inferred from a tap alone.
